title: Past Simple (Regular/Irregular verbs) - All other verbs in past

options.answer: He eat pizza for dinner last night.
He ate pizza for dinner last night.
He eated pizza for dinner last night.

explanation.en: The past simple form of the irregular verb 'eat' is 'ate'. We use this form to talk about actions that happened in the past.
explanation.ru: Простая прошедшая форма неправильного глагола 'eat' - 'ate'. Мы используем эту форму, чтобы говорить о действиях, которые произошли в прошлом.
explanation.uz: 'Eat' noto'g'ri fe'lining oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli 'ate'dir. Biz bu shakldan o'tmishda sodir bo'lgan harakatlar haqida gapirish uchun foydalanamiz.

options.answer: They did not went to the cinema.
They didn't go to the cinema.
They not went to the cinema.

explanation.en: To form a negative sentence in the past simple, we use 'did not' (or 'didn't') followed by the base form of the main verb. The past form 'went' is incorrect here.
explanation.ru: Чтобы образовать отрицательное предложение в простом прошедшем времени, мы используем 'did not' (или 'didn't'), за которым следует основная форма глагола. Прошедшая форма 'went' здесь неверна.
explanation.uz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonda inkor gap tuzish uchun biz 'did not' (yoki 'didn't') dan so'ng fe'lning asosiy shaklidan foydalanamiz. Bu yerda 'went' o'tgan zamon shakli noto'g'ri.

options.answer: We studyed for the exam yesterday.
We studied for the exam yesterday.
We studiied for the exam yesterday.

explanation.en: For regular verbs ending in a consonant + 'y', we change the 'y' to 'i' before adding '-ed' to form the past simple.
explanation.ru: Для правильных глаголов, оканчивающихся на согласную + 'y', мы меняем 'y' на 'i' перед добавлением '-ed', чтобы образовать простое прошедшее время.
explanation.uz: Undosh harf va 'y' bilan tugaydigan to'g'ri fe'llar uchun, oddiy o'tgan zamonni hosil qilish uchun '-ed' qo'shishdan oldin 'y'ni 'i'ga o'zgartiramiz.

options.answer: Did she came to the party?
Did she come to the party?
Does she came to the party?

explanation.en: When forming a question in the past simple, we use 'did' followed by the base form of the main verb, 'come'.
explanation.ru: При формировании вопроса в простом прошедшем времени, мы используем 'did', за которым следует основная форма глагола, 'come'.
explanation.uz: Oddiy o'tgan zamonda savol tuzishda, biz 'did' dan so'ng asosiy fe'lning 'come' shaklidan foydalanamiz.

options.answer: I have my keys yesterday.
I had my keys yesterday.
I had had my keys yesterday.

explanation.en: The past simple form of the verb 'have' is 'had'. We use 'had' to talk about possession in the past.
explanation.ru: Простая прошедшая форма глагола 'have' - 'had'. Мы используем 'had', чтобы говорить о владении в прошлом.
explanation.uz: 'Have' fe'lining oddiy o'tgan zamon shakli 'had'dir. Biz 'had'dan o'tmishda egalik haqida gapirish uchun foydalanamiz.

options.answer: She did not watched TV last night.

explanation.en: In negative sentences with 'did not', the main verb is always in its base form.
explanation.ru: В отрицательных предложениях с 'did not' основной глагол всегда используется в своей базовой форме.
explanation.uz: 'Did not' bilan bo'lgan inkor gaplarda, asosiy fe'l har doim o'zining asosiy shaklida bo'ladi.
